title: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show
seo_title: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show in Joplin, MO
description: Home for the HoliGays Christmas Show is a holiday evening at Blackthorn Pizza & Pub with live music, a silent auction, raffles and holiday treats. Doors open at 6 PM for bidding, treats and raffles, and the show starts at 7 PM; cover is $15, or $10 with a new toy donated to Toys for Tots. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026 at 510 S Joplin Ave in Joplin, Missouri, and the musical lineup will be released soon.
